verdict.rationale: Google's docs explicitly describe scheduling recurring actions so Gemini becomes part of daily/weekly/monthly routines (gemini-docs-8), and the Daily Brief feature autonomously delivers a personalized digest without user prompting (gemini-docs-32/41), supported by action-taking integrations with other apps (gemini-docs-10/17/23/30). However, evidence is limited to first-party docs with no independent/hands-on confirmation of reliability, no detail on trigger conditions, failure handling, or scope of what 'recurring actions' can actually do autonomously. Missing for 10: independent verification that scheduled automations run reliably unattended, documentation on trigger/condition logic, and evidence of broader autonomous multi-step task execution beyond simple digests.
